evidence.title: OpenAI: GPT 5.6 Sol price reduction (until at least Nov 21)

summary: OpenAI announced a temporary price reduction for its GPT‑5.6 Sol offering, with lower usage fees effective now and lasting until at least Nov 21. The discount is intended to make the advanced model more affordable for developers and enterprise customers as the company pushes broader adoption.
title: OpenAI cuts prices for GPT‑5.6 Sol plan through November 21
